svg.title: The title intro's layers
svg.desc: The title intro after the prologue, as the player sees it, comes apart into the four sheets the console stacks to draw it, then closes again. From the back: purple clouds around an opening of blue sky on BG1; the sun on its own patch of blue sky, a sprite; the mountain on BG2; and the lens flares, sprites in front of everything. The sun is behind the mountain: its sprite has a lower priority than BG2, so the mountain's peak covers it. The sun and the flares are added over what is behind them (alpha blending), which is why the sun's square patch melts into the sky.
svg.text: THE TITLE INTRO, AS THE PLAYER SEES IT
The mountainin front of the sun
